identity.title: ALMA resolves the remarkable molecular jet and rotating wind in the extremely radio-quiet galaxy NGC 1377

paper_type_evidence.quote: In this paper we present new high resolution (0.$''$025 $\times$ 0.$''$033) (2.5 $\times$ 3 pc) ALMA CO $J$= 3–2, HCO$^{+}$ $J$=4–3, HCN $J$=4–3 $\nu_2$=1$f$ and also H$^{13}$CN $J$=4–3 of NGC 1377.

question.value: What are the structure, kinematics, physical conditions and driving mechanisms of the molecular jet and wind in the extremely radio-quiet galaxy NGC 1377, and what is the nature of its nuclear power source?

evidence.quote: the nature of the power source behind the molecular outflow, and the FIR luminosity, is still not fully understood.

claims.finding: Accretion onto a dust-enshrouded SMBH is favoured

evidence.quote: Absence of signs of ongoing star formation lead us to suggest that it stems from accretion onto the dust-enshrouded SMBH.
